📢 Welcome to Forgotten Maze

Explore a mysterious maze, complete tasks, and find a way to escape before the monster finds you...

Be careful, every corner could be your last... Stay quiet, stay alert, and whatever you do, DON'T LET HIM FIND YOU.

Game is in BETA, so you may expect some bugs!
